name: JIAN XR
summary:
JIAN XR is an immersive platform for meeting real people and discovering culture through spatial storytelling.

Begin in passthrough, where a person appears in your room. Hear their story in their own words, explore experiences connected to their life and work, open a Portal, and step into immersive VR180 worlds.
